citation: Moseley, M. Edward; Willey, Gordon R. 1973. “Aspero, Peru: A Reexamination of the Site and Its Implications.” American Antiquity 38 (4): 452–468. DOI 10.2307/279451.
notes: Peer-reviewed American Antiquity article. Reexamines Aspero (Supe Valley mouth / central Peruvian coast) as a large preceramic sedentary community with artificial platform mounds / corporate labor structures; discusses implications for Cotton Preceramic complexity and later agricultural transfer (~2000–1800 B.C. in authors’ framing). Tier S. Absolute dates later refined by Haas/Shady radiocarbon programs — cross-check with Science 2001 / Nature 2004.
